test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of direct tax ?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Income Tax.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Direct Tax:**

 
 
• Taxes that are **imposed by the government on individuals or corporations directly.**
 
• The **same person is subject to both the incidence and the impact** of the direct tax.
 
• They are** progressive** in nature.
 
• **For example**:
 
 
• **Income tax**
 
• Corporate tax
